Auto_Cracker.name: Auto_Cracker
Auto_Cracker.note: Auto cracker: base, feed roller conveyor (-X), cracking chamber with JawL/JawR (separate, slide along X), hood window, motor (+X), control panel, output rubble bin + Fill. Front -Y.

pieces.name: JawL
pieces.note: crusher jaw; slides along X toward the middle by 0.45 studs (attach JawL_Closed); the shaft stub passes through the hub

pieces.name: JawR
pieces.note: crusher jaw; slides along X toward the middle by 0.45 studs (attach JawR_Closed); the shaft stub passes through the hub

pieces.name: Hood
pieces.note: protective window, clear Glass, transparency 0.72 so the jaws and the rock stay visible

pieces.name: Fill
pieces.note: rubble heap in the output bin; show as the bin fills, hide when empty

motion.JawL: slide along Roblox X; Blender -X side = Roblox +X side; home = JawL_Open, end = JawL_Closed (0.4 studs toward the middle)
motion.JawR: slide along Roblox X; Blender +X side = Roblox -X side; home = JawR_Open, end = JawR_Closed (0.4 studs toward the middle)
motion.Hood: static glass (hide or raise to open)

Basket_Empty.name: Basket_Empty

Basket_Filled.note: Carry basket with 5 rocks (Rocks piece separate), origin bottom centre; Grip attach = handle top centre.

pieces.note: 5 rocks; hide for the empty look

Cart_Track.name: Cart_Track
Cart_Track.note: Narrow-gauge track segment 8 long (X), sleepers on a gravel bed, rail tops at 0.66; gauge 1.5. Origin floor centre; tiles along X every 8 studs (attach Next). Decorative, walkable (no collision needed).

Cliff_A.name: Cliff_A
Cliff_A.note: Cliff module A: tall central peak, stepped shoulders, 16 x 11 footprint, origin floor centre, front (-Y) faces the arena. Box colliders in manifest `colliders`.

Cliff_B.name: Cliff_B
Cliff_B.note: Cliff module B: broad mid-height block mass, 20 x 12 footprint, origin floor centre, front (-Y) faces the arena. Box colliders in manifest `colliders`.

Cliff_C.name: Cliff_C
Cliff_C.note: Cliff module C: tall narrow column cluster, 14 x 9 footprint, origin floor centre, front (-Y) faces the arena. Box colliders in manifest `colliders`.

Cliff_Corner.name: Cliff_Corner
Cliff_Corner.note: Ledged cliff corner: L-shaped (back + left arms), inner corner faces the arena (-Y, +X). Origin floor centre of the 12 x 12 footprint; box colliders in manifest `colliders`.

Cliff_D.name: Cliff_D
Cliff_D.note: Cliff module D: stepped pyramid around a central spire, 18 x 12 footprint, origin floor centre, front (-Y) faces the arena. Box colliders in manifest `colliders`.

Cliff_E.name: Cliff_E
Cliff_E.note: Cliff module E: long low ledge (backdrop filler), 24 x 11 footprint, origin floor centre, front (-Y) faces the arena. Box colliders in manifest `colliders`.

Cliff_F.name: Cliff_F
Cliff_F.note: Cliff module F: peak to the right, low steps on the left, 16 x 11 footprint, origin floor centre, front (-Y) faces the arena. Box colliders in manifest `colliders`.

Cliff_Strata_A.name: Cliff_Strata_A
Cliff_Strata_A.note: Layered cliff wall A: six bedded layers, three broken columns; 30 wide x 9 deep. Thin uneven rock beds (Cliff / CliffDark, rare RockLight ledge), leaning face, broken columns on top, talus at the foot. Origin floor centre of the front foot line (layers reach 3 below the floor), front (-Y) faces the arena; box collider in manifest `colliders`.

Cliff_Strata_B.name: Cliff_Strata_B
Cliff_Strata_B.note: Layered cliff wall B: five layers, steeper step-back; 28 wide x 8 deep. Thin uneven rock beds (Cliff / CliffDark, rare RockLight ledge), leaning face, broken columns on top, talus at the foot. Origin floor centre of the front foot line (layers reach 3 below the floor), front (-Y) faces the arena; box collider in manifest `colliders`.

Cliff_Strata_C.name: Cliff_Strata_C
Cliff_Strata_C.note: Layered cliff wall C: seven thin beds, tall broken crown; 32 wide x 10 deep. Thin uneven rock beds (Cliff / CliffDark, rare RockLight ledge), leaning face, broken columns on top, talus at the foot. Origin floor centre of the front foot line (layers reach 3 below the floor), front (-Y) faces the arena; box collider in manifest `colliders`.

Court_Bench.name: Court_Bench
Court_Bench.note: Wooden bench (5 long), dark steel end frames, seat top at y 1.65, origin floor centre; Seat attach = seat centre.

Court_EntranceArch.name: Court_EntranceArch
Court_EntranceArch.note: Entrance arch: two stone pillars with light strips, dark segmented arch and a geode emblem (Emblem piece, amber crystal); 14 wide, about 11.5 tall, walk-through 9 wide; origin floor centre.

pieces.name: Emblem
pieces.note: amber gem on the arch crown (glows)

Court_FenceCorner.name: Court_FenceCorner
Court_FenceCorner.note: Fence corner: L of two 4-long runs meeting at a lit corner post at (-X, +Y); origin floor centre of the L's 5 x 5 box.

Court_FenceStraight.name: Court_FenceStraight
Court_FenceStraight.note: Fence straight: 8 long, stone sill, 3 dark rails, end posts with amber light strips; origin floor centre.

Court_KioskBollard.name: Court_KioskBollard
Court_KioskBollard.note: Kiosk bollard 1.6 x 1.6 x 3.2: dark post, glowing front window (Glow piece), slanted top screen (Screen piece); origin floor centre.

Court_PathArrow.name: Court_PathArrow
Court_PathArrow.note: Path arrow inset: 6 x 6 paving tile with a dark inset and a glowing chevron (Arrow piece, Neon) pointing to the front (Roblox -Z), origin floor centre.

pieces.name: Arrow
pieces.note: glowing chevron; pulse it to guide players

Court_PerimeterWall.name: Court_PerimeterWall
Court_PerimeterWall.note: Low perimeter wall 10 long x 1.4 deep x 3 tall: dark base course, beige blocks, taller end block at -X; origin floor centre.

Court_Planter.note: Stone planter 6 x 2.6 x 1.5 with shrubs and yellow flowers, origin floor centre.

Court_StationPad.note: Station floor pad (courtyard version), 10 x 10 dark tiles, light rim, Accent corner brackets, top at y 0.45, origin floor centre.

Court_Tree.name: Court_Tree
Court_Tree.note: Small low-poly tree in a square stone planter (3.6 x 3.6), about 9 tall, origin floor centre.

Court_WalkwayCorner.note: Walkway L corner, 8 x 8 outline with a 4 x 4 notch at the back-right, top at y 0.85, origin floor centre of the 8 x 8 square.

Court_WalkwayStraight.name: Court_WalkwayStraight
Court_WalkwayStraight.note: Walkway straight, 8 long (X) x 4 wide, slabs on a dark base course, top at y 0.8, origin floor centre.

Court_WallLamp.note: Wall lamp: back plate + arm + lantern (Glow piece, Neon). Origin = bottom centre of the back plate on the wall; the lamp sticks out to the front (-Y / Roblox -Z).

Fence_Section.name: Fence_Section
Fence_Section.note: Wooden fence section: two bolted steel posts, two plank rails; 6 long x 3.2 tall. Origin floor centre; tiles along X every 6 studs (the next section shares the right post).

Gallery_Bench.name: Gallery_Bench

Grit_Patch.note: Decorative ground grit (non-interactive, no collision), origin floor centre, about 5 x 3 studs.

pieces.name: Screen
pieces.note: SurfaceGui on its top face

Lobby7_SellChute.note: Compact rubble receiving bin: flared charcoal bin with a short wood front lip, sloped steel chute inside, slate service base with a small output tray, one small status Lamp piece on a short post and a pale Plaque piece on the front (SurfaceGui). pieces.name: Plaque

pieces.name: Screen

pieces.name: Screen

pieces.name: Screen
pieces.note: touch screen; SurfaceGui on its top face (party slots)

Terminal_StepTile.name: Terminal_StepTile
Terminal_StepTile.note: Kiosk step / paving tile 6 x 4 x 0.75: dark base course, stone slabs with chunky end blocks; origin floor centre.

Tool_Jackhammer.note: Jackhammer: amber body, two black grips on a crossbar, vents, hose stub, silver bit (separate Bit piece); origin = handlebar centre.

Tool_SteelHammer.name: Tool_SteelHammer

Track_Buffer.note: Track buffer stop: 3 of track ending in a timber stop block with an amber bumper beam facing -X. Origin floor centre; the track runs in from -X.

Wall_Lamp.note: Wall lamp: bolted wall plate, curved steel arm, caged amber lantern (Lamp piece = the glow). Origin = back centre of the wall plate (sits on the wall surface, front -Y); add a PointLight at attach `Light`.
